clue.text: Soldier fights, we hear, to use other words

parts.note: PARA is short for a paratrooper

indicators.note: signals that a word is to be taken by how it is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: frays are brawls or scuffles

explanation.surface: A soldier's brawls are described, apparently, in roundabout language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' turns FRAYS (fights) into its sound-alike PHRASE, added to PARA.
explanation.definitionFit: To restate something in different wording is the verb's whole meaning.

clue.text: Father's twin almost reaching Italian city

parts.note: PA is an informal word for father

indicators.note: tells us to drop the final letter of the synonym for twin

parts.note: dual means double or twin, as in dual carriageway

explanation.surface: A dad's twin sibling nearly arrives in an Italian town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts DUAL (twin) to DUA.
explanation.definitionFit: Padua is a university city in the Veneto region of northern Italy.

indicators.note: something complicated is tangled, so the following word's letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Duplicating a tricky process.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complicated' rearranges PROCEDURE.
explanation.definitionFit: To copy something is to make a duplicate of it, a synonym of the verb.

clue.text: How to display a statue that's highly valued?

definitions.text: How to display a statue that's highly valued?

parts.words: How to display a statue that's highly valued?
parts.note: literally, a statue is set up on a plinth; figuratively, someone highly valued is idolised beyond criticism

explanation.surface: A question about how to show off a prized sculpture.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means idolising someone, as a statue is raised up on a plinth.

parts.note: red is a bright, vivid colour
a shock of hair is a thick head of hair

explanation.surface: A surprising flash of light wins over a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shock' reads as a jolt, but it is a mass of hair: a shock of red is a red head of hair. The clue as printed lacks its letter count (7).
explanation.definitionFit: A girl with red hair is commonly called by this name for her hair colour.

clue.text: Condition's about right to create low cloud

indicators.note: the word for condition goes around the letter for right

parts.note: status is one's condition or standing

explanation.surface: A state of affairs is apparently just right to bring grey skies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' places STATUS around R.
explanation.definitionFit: Stratus is a flat grey cloud layer lying at low altitude.

clue.text: Mark is caught in top military base

indicators.note: the letter for mark is trapped inside the word for top

parts.note: a cap is a lid or top
M is the abbreviation for the German mark currency

explanation.surface: A mark is found in the highest army post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is caught in' puts M inside CAP.
explanation.definitionFit: A camp is a place where troops are quartered, so it serves as a base.

parts.note: the mass is the bulk or greater part

explanation.surface: Most people are urged to assemble.
explanation.definitionFit: To accumulate or gather in quantity is the verb's sense.

clue.text: Introduce conservation group as classic example

parts.note: to precede is to come before and so introduce
NT is the National Trust, the British heritage conservation charity

explanation.surface: Launching an environmental society as a model case.
explanation.walkthrough: NT is the National Trust, which looks after historic houses and countryside in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A case that serves as a model for later ones sets the standard to follow.

indicators.note: doing something wildly suggests disorder, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A man applauds a woman with great enthusiasm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wildly' rearranges HE CLAPPED SUSAN.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means extremely happy, after the gleeful puppet Mr Punch.

indicators.note: the word for place sits inside the word for conveyance

parts.note: a conveyance is a legal deed transferring property
to put is to place

explanation.surface: Something allotted a spot inside a vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conveyance' suggests a vehicle but in law it is a deed; 'in' puts PUT inside DEED.
explanation.definitionFit: Deputed means delegated, given a task to carry out on another's behalf.

definitions.meaning: to free is to let go or liberate
an issue is something put out, such as a record or film

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both letting go of a captive and a new record or film put out to the public.

clue.text: Worker set about production of modern decorative item

indicators.note: the insect is placed around the scrambled letters

parts.note: an ant is the crossword's favourite worker insect

indicators.note: producing something from raw letters means rearranging them here

explanation.surface: An employee starts on making a contemporary ornament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'production of' rearranges MODERN into DORNME, which 'set about' places inside ANT.
explanation.definitionFit: An ornament or embellishment is a decoration added for beauty.

clue.text: Way off-shore it lies by the sound of it

indicators.note: tells us the entry is spoken the same as the word described

parts.note: an island lies off the shore

explanation.surface: A route that seems to tell an untruth from beyond the coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lies' reads as telling untruths but it means being situated.
explanation.definitionFit: A passage between rows of seats is a way through.

parts.note: a plum job is a choice one

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A big selection placed before the head of a political group.
explanation.definitionFit: Plump describes something rounded and fat, hence big.

parts.note: to post is to send by mail
expedition can mean speed or promptness

explanation.surface: Dispatching a journey of exploration immediately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expedition' suggests a journey, but it also means speed.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means with all speed, immediately.

clue.text: Somehow be misled about society cover up

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go around the letter for society
suggests these letters reach the result by some unspecified rearrangement

explanation.surface: Being deceived regarding a social concealment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somehow' rearranges BE MISLED, and 'about' puts that around S.
explanation.definitionFit: To dissemble is to conceal one's true motives or feelings.

parts.note: to back someone is to support them
a biter is something that nips

explanation.surface: Support a little child who has a speech problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nipper' looks like a child but is literally one that bites; 'speaks badly' means speaking ill of others.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who slanders others behind their back is one who disparages them.

parts.note: to speed is to rush
well means successfully or satisfactorily

explanation.surface: Bed in seedlings quickly and to good effect.
explanation.definitionFit: Speedwell is a small flowering plant with blue flowers, a veronica.

parts.note: words written in memory of the dead, typically carved on a gravestone

explanation.surface: A question about dull, lifeless writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deathly prose' suggests boring writing, but it means writing about death.
explanation.definitionFit: An inscription on a tomb is a few lines commemorating the deceased.

definitions.meaning: the morning star, Venus, was once given this Latin name meaning light-bringer
an old name for a friction match

explanation.surface: The top performer in a sporting fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Star of the match' reads as a player of the game; 'of the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The name means light-bearer, given both to the morning star and to early strike-anywhere matches.

clue.text: Hear a famous explorer is in Berkshire

indicators.note: tells us the words are spoken, giving a sound-alike spelling

parts.note: Robert Falcon Scott, the Antarctic explorer, so 'a Scott'

explanation.surface: Listen: a renowned adventurer lives in an English county.
explanation.walkthrough: Berkshire is an English county west of London; Ascot there is famous for its racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascot is a town in the county of Berkshire, home of a royal racecourse.

clue.text: Start off sung work composed to Egyptian god

indicators.note: the first letter is removed from the word for a sung work

parts.note: a chorus is a composition for singers

explanation.surface: A choral piece written for an ancient deity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Start off' drops the C from CHORUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Horus is the falcon-headed sky deity of ancient Egypt.

definitions.meaning: spools or bobbins on which thread or film is wound

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both lively Scottish dances and spools for winding thread or fishing line.

clue.text: Trendy aide brought into line is incompetent

parts.note: in means fashionable

indicators.note: the assistant's letters are put inside the word for line

parts.note: a cable is a line or wire
a PA is a personal assistant

explanation.surface: A fashionable assistant made to toe the line proves useless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought into' puts PA inside CABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Unable to do something properly is the sense of lacking competence.

parts.note: an earl holds a noble title

explanation.surface: A nobleman joined twelve months ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Early means in advance of the usual time, hence before.

clue.text: Composer from Wales met an admirer

indicators.note: the answer is taken out of the run of letters in these words

explanation.surface: A musician from Wales encountered a fan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' looks like part of 'from Wales'; the answer runs through waleS MET AN Admirer.
explanation.definitionFit: Bedrich Smetana was a Czech composer, writer of Ma Vlast.

clue.text: As a joker, fellow has unrest sorted out

indicators.note: letters that are sorted out are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man known as a prankster has calmed the trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sorted out' rearranges UNREST into UNSTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who makes fun is a jester or comic.

definitions.meaning: time free from work, relaxed comfort
facility means ... of doing, as in 'with great facility'

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both relaxed comfort or rest and the effortlessness of doing something skilfully.

parts.note: a British Anglican evangelistic organisation named as if it were a military force

explanation.surface: A description of faith's influence across the UK.
explanation.definitionFit: The Church Army is an Anglican evangelist society in Britain, organised on a military model.
